[LUNI.8.7.4] **The dimension is the scale-free dimension.** A value a
`::<unit>` cast gives is held in the base unit ([LUNI.8.5]). The facet the cast contributes to the [LUNI.8] checks is therefore the
unit's *dimension* (`temperature`, `length`, …), not its scale (`celsius` vs
`kelvin`). Same-dimension checks resolve at the base-unit level, so
`r.a::celsius + r.b::kelvin` is valid ([LUNI.8.1]) — both are `temperature`.
